# Frozen pre-migration scVI recipient fixture

`phase6_scvi_old_core_historical.bundle.tar.gz` was generated by the adjacent
builder from accepted pre-migration core commit
`b564d10cdb5aee757a0c8401ab15f69594d12ea0`. It contains a finalized
bundle with one promoted historical `scvi_train` model artifact and a fitted
space. The model is a deliberately small contained test tree, not a trained
scientific model. The archive SHA-256 is
`be1114ecf1be9415f2744c963a9fcd1582f967c1f3c2bf8789ccffc278920a28`.

The ownership regression extracts a disposable copy and uses only read-only
recipient validation and public inspection without activating scwbLatent.
It fingerprints all copied files before and after. The frozen archive is not
rewritten by tests.
